beats.say: Two actors: Walter Koenig was one of only two people to audition for Chekov.
That is a shorter queue than a morning coffee run for a role that defined a career.
The Chicago born actor joined the original Star Trek television series in its second season.
He played Ensign Pavel Chekov, a character who became a favourite for generations of fans.
Away from the bridge, he was a close friend to his crew, even serving as best man at George Takei's wedding.
The Star Trek legend passed away on 25 October 2026, leaving behind a massive legacy from that one tiny audition.
